versions.content: If ActiveDiagnostic is 'DCM_COMM_ACTIVE' and the Dcm is do- ing a transition into 'active' diagnostic state of a diagnostic protocol, the Dcm shall call ComM_DCM_ActiveDiagnostic(NetworkId), with the networkId associated to the re- ceived Pdu (see DcmDslProtocolComMChannelRef ), with every request, to inform the ComM module about the need to stay in Full Communication Mode.
